findings.rationale: The Ensembl canonical sequence is 748 aa, while the UniProt F5H094 and studied LST-3TM12 protein are 687 aa. The study cannot establish the selected 748-aa product.
findings.limitations: The native hepatocyte findings concern the studied product; normal-tissue hazard requires its independent assessment.

findings.rationale: The reviewed study challenges protein production with tagged endogenous-ORF experiments, Ribo-seq/proteomic analyses and evidence of RNA function. Coding annotation alone does not resolve this counterevidence.
findings.limitations: Negative results concern the tested systems and do not prove absence of protein in every tissue or tumor.
